column1: # Full commit SHAs for registry locations that pin an abbreviated SHA
# (RLT-007a H3). scripts/fetch-sources.py fetches the full SHA and refuses a
# row whose SHA does not begin with the registry's abbreviation.
# Resolved 2026-11-12 with `git rev-parse ABBREV^{commit}` in clones of each
# repository; check_excerpts.py still reads `git show ABBREV:PATH`.
